Matt — thanks for the clear rundown. Attaching a draft amendment (redwood_provisioning_amendment_v2.pdf) and a proposed throughput schedule that mirrors your expected ramp. High-level proposal:

- Phased commit: 500M tokens/mo (current) -> 700M (Aug–Sep) -> 900M (Oct) -> 1.1B (Nov) with a three-month rate guarantee after final uplift.
- Tiered unit price: blended price tiers that lower unit cost as you step up commits; we'll include an explicit per-token price per band in the amendment.
- Per-route rate fencing: we propose route-level soft caps + a separate burst window that allows short bursts at a defined overage rate.
- Throttle behavior: if sustained concurrency exceeds routing capacity, requests will be moved to a compatible model variant (fallback) — we'll keep telemetry and logs for routing decisions.

Questions for you: does the phased timeline above align with your launch? Any preference on how you want burst windows sized (e.g., 5-minute vs 15-minute)?

Ben/Marissa — looping you in for pricing/ops confirmation before I send to procurement. I put placeholder numbers in the sheet.

Cheers,

Thanks, Jasmine. I reviewed the numbers and adjusted the pricing sheet:

- Introduced a mid-tier discount for the 700–900M band (3.5% below standard hosted rate) to smooth the step.
- Burst window: recommend a 10-minute sliding window with a burst allowance equal to 150% of committed throughput, billed per-second above commit at the standard burst surcharge.
- Per-route fencing: we can enforce soft caps per route (e.g., search API: 60% of committed throughput, recs API: 25%, misc: 15%) with alerting and automated fallbacks.

Operational notes: Dedicated telemetry hooks will be available in the Console so ParcelVista can create alerts tied to the route-level metrics; we can also give a weekly export of routing decisions for the first two months.

Marissa — can you confirm the SLA language for the three-month rate guarantee and the treatment for overages during the phased uplift?

Folks — confirmed on SLA language. Proposed legal-friendly bullets we'll add to the amendment:

- Three-month rate guarantee: following the final uplift to 1.1B tokens, per-token pricing for the committed band is fixed for 90 days. No retroactive pricing changes for that period.
- Overages during phased months: we apply the agreed burst surcharge in the sheet; overages above the burst allowance will be credited at 50% of the overage charge if caused by platform routing fallback.
- Term: 12 months with a single annual true-up.

Also added a clause that allows ParcelVista to request a one-time rollback of the final uplift within 30 days of the Nov launch if production reveals a sustained lower-than-expected consumption (this protects them during the first big ramp).

Attaching updated amendment and throughput schedule. Elaine/procurement — if you can confirm legal redlines, we will prepare a DocuSign powerform for signature.
